name: spellkave_define_capability
label: Define Capability (verb)
description: Author ONE capability_definitions row (+ capability_definition_tag satellites) in a single call — the #1968 verb-UX round's named missing bare-vocabulary verb. Self-scaffolds the [[bundles]] header if `bundle` has none yet. capability_definitions is referenced from MANY affordance_templates/action_definitions rows (not satellite-owned by a single parent) — those stay on spellkave_write_rows/spellkave_define_behavior, whichever fits the calling context. #1968 workspace idempotency: re-authoring the SAME bundle+id REPLACES the row + its tag satellite wholesale (fewer tags on a re-run means the stale ones are gone, not left behind).

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on every generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

id.description: Local capability_id stem; the full id is '<bundle>/<id>' (e.g. bundle='core', id='walk' -> 'core/walk'). A handful of corpus capability ids are DELIBERATELY cross-namespace (e.g. 'frontier.apply_manifest' under bundle_id='core') — this verb always derives '<bundle>/<id>', so a cross-namespace id stays on spellkave_write_rows (mirrors spellkave_define_entity_type's own cross-namespace carve-out).

actor_kind.description: capability_definitions.actor_kind — an open string (the corpus already uses more than one value, e.g. 'entity', 'operator'); no closed PoC enum.

display_name.description: capability_definitions.display_name. Omit to derive a title-cased `id` (#1968 smart default).

description.description: capability_definitions.description — REQUIRED (unlike every OTHER verb's optional `description?`): CapabilityDefinitionRow kept its own PRE-EXISTING required description column through the #1968 description-column decision (no `#[serde(default)]` in the schema); omitting it would author an invalid row, not merely a less-documented one (same carve-out as spellkave_define_niche's own required `description`).

default_visibility.description: capability_definitions.default_visibility — the ADR-0120 read-visibility default concrete grants inherit unless overridden. Omit to default 'Public' (#1968 smart default — matches the schema's own `default_public()` serde default).
